shortDescription: Local-first multi-currency personal & solo-business financial ledger with life-hours opportunity cost, reverse budgeting, and tax reserve firewalls.
fullDescription:
Equinox Ledger is a privacy-first, multi-currency financial workspace designed for individuals, freelancers, and solopreneurs.

Instead of forcing rigid category micro-budgets or uploading bank credentials to third-party servers, Equinox computes your Daily Safe-to-Spend Allowance (Reverse Budgeting), converts every expense into Life Hours based on your true net hourly rate, and automatically partitions incoming business revenue into an untouchable Tax Reserve.

Key Features:
• Net Hourly Earning Engine — View every transaction in both nominal currency and Life Hours of labor.
• Reverse Budgeting & Safe-to-Spend Gauge — Deducts tax reserves and fixed monthly commitments automatically so you know your exact guilt-free daily allowance.
• Solo-Biz vs. Personal Tax Firewall — Tag revenue and deductible business expenses; export accountant-ready CSV and JSON reports.
• Multi-Currency & FX Runway — Track accounts across USD, EUR, GBP, TRY, CHF, and JPY with real-time living runway in months.
• Quick-Entry NLP Omnibar (Ctrl+K) — Log expenses or income in under 2 seconds using plain language.
• Impulse Cooling-Off List — Enforce labor-based waiting periods on high-ticket purchases.
• Dual Theme — Switch seamlessly between Matte Carbon Dark Theme and Warm Editorial Paper Light Theme.
• 100% Local-First Privacy — Zero cloud telemetry, zero tracking, and portable .equinox.json vault backups.
